target.purpose: Preserve material multi-sensor disagreement as explicit authority-bounding evidence rather than averaging it away.
current_mechanisms: MEDIUM review escalation and HIGH+ fail-closed freeze
bounded stable-window recovery that only releases a prior freeze into review
deterministic majority and freeze selection across concurrent sensor arrival
target.next_bottleneck: Sensor signatures are currently evidence fields bound into fingerprints, not authenticated identities; cluster and recovery lineage also needs durable receipt chaining.

invariants: HIGH and CRITICAL dissent cannot be averaged away
a frozen state cannot auto-recover directly to normal observation
evolution preserves repository identity and lineage
nonclaims: no Anduril affiliation or production Lattice deployment
no cryptographic verification of SensorOpinion.signature yet
